title: Storage Rental Rate Schedule
content:
Each Storage Rental product carries a standard monthly rent, in US dollars per month, and the rent billing terms set out against it.

| Storage Rental product | Standard monthly rent | Rent posts on day of month | Partial-month proration method | Last month prorated to the end date | Rent held for (months after the rental starts) | Written notice before an increase (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | $15.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | $35.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | $55.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | $85.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | $115.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | Yes | 12 | 30 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | $165.00 | 1 | Actual days in the month | No | 12 | 30 |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. *Proration method.* "Actual days in the month" means that a partial month is measured against the number of days the calendar month actually has, for every Storage Rental product.
2. *Last month.* For the five products marked "Yes", the last month's rent is prorated to the end date. For the Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), marked "No", the last month is billed in full.
3. *Rent hold.* Every Storage Rental product holds its monthly rent for 12 months after the rental starts, and requires 30 calendar days of written notice before a rent increase.
4. *Posting day.* Monthly storage rent for every product posts on the 1st day of the month.

**Schedule at a glance**

- Lowest monthly rent: Bike Storage Locker, $15.00.
- Highest monthly rent: Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), $165.00.
- The two 5 by 10 products differ by $30.00 a month: the Large Storage Unit (5x10) at $85.00 and the Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) at $115.00.
